hero.title: Rent the tractor. Plan the harvest. Pay over time.
hero.subtitle: agriLease is where farmers in Morocco find machines to rent or buy from owners nearby, keep track of their fields and workers, and apply for equipment financing.
hero.imageAlt: Aerial view of wheat fields and olive groves in Fès-Meknès, Morocco, at golden hour
hero.factCurrency: Prices in dirhams, per day or to buy
hero.factFinancing: Bank loans, leasing and public programmes
hero.photoCaption: Wheat and olive groves near Meknès, early morning.

story.forFarmersTitle: Know what every field needs this week
story.forFarmersDescription: Ferme Ait Yahya keeps wheat, barley, olives and citrus in four fields on one screen: what is growing, when each field is due for harvest, and who is working today.
story.forOwnersTitle: Rent out a tractor without losing track of it
story.forOwnersDescription: Owners set a daily rate, approve each request, and see running hours, distance and service alerts for every machine, such as a hydraulic pressure drop on a John Deere 6R 155.
story.sectionEyebrow: For farmers and for equipment owners
story.sectionTitle: The paperwork of a farm, kept in one notebook
story.forFinancingTitle: See the monthly payment before you talk to a bank
story.forFinancingDescription: Enter the price and your down payment, compare bank loans, leasing and programmes such as FDA and Tamwilcom side by side, then send your application with its documents.

footer.tagline: Farm records, equipment rental and financing for farmers in Morocco.

finalCta.title: Start with one field. Add the rest when you're ready.

howItWorks.title: From sign-up to a machine in your field
howItWorks.step1Description: Mark your fields on the map and note what is planted in each one, from Fès-Meknès to Souss-Massa.
howItWorks.step2Description: Rent a tractor, harvester or sprayer by the day from an owner near you, or make an offer to buy one.
howItWorks.step3Title: Pay over time if you need to
howItWorks.step3Description: Compare financing offers for the machine you chose and apply online. A banker reviews your file and replies in the app.

vegetationMap.title: Vegetation (NDVI)
vegetationMap.subtitle: How green the land is, from 16-day MODIS satellite composites, with your fields on top.
vegetationMap.legendScale: Bare or sparse → dense green vegetation
vegetationMap.whatIs: NDVI compares how much red and near-infrared light the land reflects. Growing green plants score high (about 0.6–0.9), bare soil and dry stubble score low (0–0.2).
vegetationMap.whatIsNot: It is not a direct measure of crop health or yield. A low value can mean drought, but also a field that was just harvested, ploughed, or not sown yet. Use it to spot changes, then go and look.
vegetationMap.resolution: Each pixel is 250 m wide, so a small field is only a few pixels: read it as the area around your field.
vegetationMap.source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD13 16-day NDVI (250 m), via NASA GIBS.
vegetationMap.noFieldsHint: Add fields to your farms to see them outlined here.
